evidence.quote: NEWTON University Angels s.r.o., osoba rizikového kapitálu
Our fund brings together investor capital and allocates it to selected projects led by talented individuals.
Průměrná výše jedné investice je aktuálně 300 tisíc korun, ve druhém fondu se má navýšit na 500 tisíc.
In one of the last TakeUp projects we invested in, we raised many times that amount.

analyst_notes: Pooled fund of investor capital run by NEWTON University (Michal Tesař): eight funded projects listed without dates (NerveCor, Flexible Frame, LoveGuard, Take up, Bogroti, Believer, Basefound, AntsPark). CzechCrunch (2024-02-06) reported five investments and a planned second fund of about CZK 5m; the 2024-05-31 interview mentions Take Up as one of the latest deals. Typed vc (pooled capital, minority equity, pre-seed). Re-screen if NerveCor / Flexible Frame / LoveGuard deals turn out to be dated after 2024-10-25. A CzechStartups interview could not be fetched (connection refused).
